text:
Mei Chen: Hi team — I submitted my resignation, last day will be 2026-04-15. Can someone outline benefits cutoff, COBRA steps, and access removal?
People Ops Bot: Thanks Mei. A People Ops rep will DM you within 1 business day. Please confirm preferred personal email for benefits/COBRA.
Mei Chen: Use mei.chen+personal@gmail.com.
Dana Ortiz: Hi Mei, Dana from People Ops here. Quick summary: company medical benefits remain effective through 2026-04-30 (end of month). COBRA election window starts when the COBRA packet is issued; you have 60 days to elect. Final paycheck will be processed on the next payroll after 4/15 and will include prorated PTO and any expense reimbursements. 401(k) info will be sent from Fidelity — we'll DM the contact.
Mei Chen: Will COBRA docs arrive by email or snail mail?
Dana Ortiz: We'll email the initial packet to mei.chen+personal@gmail.com and upload PDFs to the employee portal. Physical mail only if requested.
Ash Patel: From eng manager — thanks for the heads up. Can you list repo/service access you need through your last day? I'll coordinate handover and make a note for rotation of responsibilities.
Mei Chen: infra-ops, model-serving, shared-embeddings. I only actually need access until 2026-04-10 to finish the migration.
Ash Patel: Cool. IT: can we keep SSO active until 2026-04-16 09:00 PT so she can finish cleanup?
IT Oncall: Submit an offboard ticket with the quick command below and we'll schedule removals:
```
/offboard create --user mei.chen --last-day 2026-04-15 --assets laptop,hotspot --remove-after 2026-04-16
```
IT Oncall: Once ticket is in, we'll revoke IAM roles for infra-ops and model-serving on 2026-04-16 09:00 PT, disable SSO same time, and keep email forwarding to personal for 2026-04-30. Laptop pickup will be coordinated with courier; please leave device in the office drop box if remote pickup isn't available.
Mei Chen: Thanks. Is healthcare premium for April pro-rated?
Dana Ortiz: No pro-rate. Employer coverage runs through 4/30. Any payroll reconciliation happens on the final paycheck.
Mei Chen: I'd like an exit interview. Prefer week of 4/6.
People Ops Bot: Exit interview poll sent. Tentative slot booked: 2026-04-12 10:00 PT. Calendar invite sent.
Mei Chen: Confirmed.
Ash Patel: Also flagged two sensitive creds in infra-ops. Mei, please rotate/revoke or leave notes before 4/10 EOD so we can remove them safely.
Mei Chen: Will do. I'll add a handover doc in /docs/offboard-mei and a short README in infra-ops.
Dana Ortiz: Uploading the official offboarding checklist to Confluence and DMing the COBRA/401k forms now. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/offboard-checklist (internal).
IT Oncall: Ticket OFF-3421 created. Laptop pickup scheduled for 2026-04-18. We'll post back here after IAM removal.
Mei Chen: Thanks everyone — timeline makes this much less stressful.
People Ops Bot: OFF-3421 updated: COBRA packet queued, assets/laptop pickup scheduled.
IT Oncall: IAM roles removed and SSO disabled on 2026-04-16 09:00 PT — email forwarding remains until 2026-04-30.
Mei Chen: Confirmed I received the COBRA email and the exit interview invite. Appreciate all the help.
